Monsoon arrives in parts of Haryana and Punjab

The monsoon has reached certain areas of Haryana and Punjab, marking its arrival in these northern Indian states. This development signifies the beginning of the seasonal rainfall in the region. The arrival of the monsoon is a significant event for agriculture and water resources in these states.
